name: ao_ticket_reply_notify
description: Fires when support posts an external reply on a ticket thread. Notifies the ticket owner in-app and emails them when the transactional-email integration (Resend) is configured.

config.message: Support replied to your ticket — open {{brand.name}} to read it.

metadata.note: send_email no-ops until RESEND_API_KEY is configured; recipients 'owner' resolves the ticket creator. Recipients list accepts 'owner', 'watchers', 'self', 'role:<slug>', person UUIDs, or literal emails.

name: ao_auto_embed_on_publish
description: Triggered when an Answer Once KB article or shared artifact is published. Generates embeddings via the canonical kb_ingest typed path.

metadata.note: kb_ingest calls _shared/kb.ts kbIngest (content-hash document lease). item_id resolves from trigger data; account_id is passed through from the entity snapshot so cross-account (platform/tenant) publishes embed correctly.

name: ao_auto_revoke_on_unpublish
description: Triggered when an Answer Once KB article or shared artifact leaves published status. Revokes embeddings so they are excluded from retrieval.

metadata.note: kb_revoke calls _shared/kb.ts kbRevoke — deletes embeddings and clears the document lease so a republished article re-ingests cleanly.
